name: Matzo
siboNotes: Traditional wheat-based matzo is high in fructans and should be avoided during SIBO treatment. Even small servings can trigger symptoms in sensitive individuals.
preparationTips: Look for gluten-free matzo made from rice or potato flour
Check ingredient lists as some brands may contain onion powder
Consider using rice cakes as a similar crunchy alternative
If consuming traditional matzo, limit to very small portions initially
nutritionalHighlights: Contains B vitamins from wheat flour
